what_it_does: Simulating supercritical flames (combustion at extreme pressures with detailed chemistry) has been limited to millions of grid cells due to computational expense. DeepFlame is a neural-network-enhanced simulator that enables these detailed flame simulations to scale to trillions of cells. The system incorporates optimizations for parallel computing performance, energy efficiency, and input/output operations, with tuning for Japanese supercomputers Sunway and Fugaku.
